abstract: A 55-year-old woman presented with vaginal bleeding. A tumor was found in the cervix; it was composed of 2 distinctive elements: a clear-cell adenocarcinoma and a choriocarcinoma. Histologic findings suggested that the choriocarcinomatous element was derived from a preexisting clear-cell adenocarcinoma through a metaplastic process.
abstract_ja: 55歳女性が膣出血で受診した。子宮頸部に腫瘍が認められ、明細胞腺癌と絨毛癌の2つの成分から構成されていた。組織学的所見から、絨毛癌成分は既存の明細胞腺癌から化生過程を経て生じたことが示唆された。
